answer_1.quote: We introduce IRIS ... where LLMs are asked to make their own outputs more harmful. Our experiments show that IRIS jailbreaks GPT-4 ... with over 98% attack success rate (ASR) in under 13 queries.
answer_1.outputs: harmful tutorial text (e.g., bomb-making instructions, extremist content) generated to assess jailbreak success

answer_2.quote: We calculate ASR based on human evaluation instead of using GPT-4 as a judge.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation is completed by an in-house annotator who achieved 100% agreement with authors in a training tutorial that contains 30 examples.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess whether the model response fulfills the adversarial request (i.e., constitutes a successful jailbreak) and its level of harmfulness.
